blurb: The Tennis & Racquet Club has stood at 939 Boylston Street, in the heart of Boston’s Back Bay, since 1902. Behind its classical revival façade lies one of the most distinctive athletic and social institutions in the country: the original court tennis court, the regal ancestor of every racquet sport that followed; one of only a handful of racquets courts in North America; and a championship-caliber squash program.
